name: ibm_cos_hmac_key_recognizer
note: IBM Cloud Object Storage HMAC secret access key: 48 hex characters assigned to a secret_access_key-style variable (optionally prefixed ibm/cos/hmac). Source: detect-secrets (Apache-2.0) detect_secrets/plugins/ibm_cos_hmac.py (case-insensitive). Trailing hex lookahead approximated with \b; the match includes the variable name.
